mentions.heading: Tax legislation changes including OBBBA and CAMT
mentions.detail: Subject to Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax with no current liability; OBBBA interpretation could create CAMT liability
mentions.quote: While we are subject to the Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax (“CAMT”), we currently have no CAMT liability. However, future changes in our financial results, business operations, or the interpretation and implementation of the OBBBA could result in a CAMT liability in subsequent periods.

mentions.heading: Social and environmental responsibility regulations may complicate supply chain
mentions.detail: OEMs demand minerals not sourced from conflict areas such as Democratic Republic of Congo, affecting mineral availability and pricing
mentions.quote: In addition, an increasing number of OEMs are seeking to source products that do not contain minerals sourced from areas where proceeds from the sale of such minerals are likely to be used to fund armed conflicts, such as in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

mentions.heading: Social and environmental responsibility regulations may complicate supply chain
mentions.risk_name: ESG ratings and cost of capital
mentions.detail: Unfavorable ESG ratings could hurt stock price, access to and cost of capital
mentions.quote: In addition, unfavorable ratings or assessment of our corporate social and environmental policies and programs, including our compliance with certain voluntary disclosure standards and frameworks, may lead to negative investor sentiment toward us, which could have a negative impact on our stock price and our access to and cost of capital.

mentions.heading: Social and environmental responsibility regulations may complicate supply chain
mentions.detail: Net zero emissions goal by 2040 may require material expenditures and disrupt operations
mentions.quote: Furthermore, in pursuit of our goal to achieve net zero emissions by 2040, or in response to future customer or investor expectations and regulatory requirements, we may take certain actions that may result in material expenditures that could impact our financial condition or results of operations and/or disrupt our existing operations.

mentions.heading: Our debt could materially adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations
mentions.detail: $3,004.9 million principal outstanding at Dec 31, 2025; about $1.5 billion available under Revolving Credit Facility
mentions.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had $3,004.9 million of outstanding principal relating to our indebtedness.

mentions.heading: Inability to meet Credit Agreement obligations could materially affect us
mentions.detail: Credit Agreement secured by substantially all guarantor assets and subsidiary equity pledges; mandatory prepayment if draws exceed commitments
mentions.quote: The obligations under the Credit Agreement are collateralized by a lien on substantially all of the assets of the guarantors under the Credit Agreement, including a pledge of the equity interests in certain of our domestic and first-tier foreign subsidiaries.
